description: A runnable demo: a fake recorder vendor, a fake notes app, and a local stand-in model, all Python on loopback.

disposable.description: The demo app keeps all state in files under the session folder. Nothing outside it is ever deleted.

summarize.prompt_prefix: You are a meeting summarization assistant

link.prompt_prefix: You are linking a meeting summary

limitations: The model is a local deterministic stand-in, so evals here test the pipeline, not model quality.
The demo app has one planted bug: it does not deduplicate repeated webhook deliveries. The dup scenario exposes it.
